product: 无线蓝牙耳机（ANC 降噪）
reviews: The noise cancellation is amazing, blocks out everything on the subway.
Battery life is terrible, only lasts about 3 hours which is way less than advertised.
Very comfortable to wear for long periods, I forget they're in my ears.
Sound quality is great for the price, crisp and clear.
The earbuds keep disconnecting from my phone every few minutes, very annoying.
ANC is okay but the touch controls are unresponsive half the time.
Excellent value for money, best earbuds under $50.
They hurt my ears after an hour, the tips are too big.
Charging case stopped working after 2 months, poor quality.
Bluetooth range is bad, drops connection when phone is in my pocket.
The bass is really punchy, great for music lovers.
Microphone quality during calls is terrible, the other person can't hear me.
Battery drain is real, they don't last a full workday.
Love the compact design, fits nicely in my pocket.
Customer service was helpful when I had an issue.
The left earbud has lower volume than the right one, manufacturing defect.
Fast charging is a nice touch, 10 minutes gives 2 hours.
They fit well but the case feels cheap and plasticky.
Good sound isolation in the office, helps me focus.
Pairing with my laptop was a pain, took several tries.
Waterproof rating is a lie, they died after light rain.
The app is buggy and hard to navigate.
Worth every penny, upgraded from a more expensive brand.
Latency is noticeable when watching videos, lip sync is off.
